Dilation virial identity gives E x²=w/(3kappa) and p=w/(4w-3Omega), with the correct Fourier convention. The latter is uniform X in [-1,1]. Exact second moment 1/3 gives uniform integrability and E|X|->1/2. Thus coherence sqrt(3p(1-p))*eta gives R_infty and stated eigenvalues. Airy zero r_n³/n²->(3pi/4)² gives z³(z-1)=(3pi s/4)²; p decreases 1 to 1/4 and p(1-p) is uniquely maximized at p=1/2, z=3/2, s=sqrt(3)/pi. Independently evaluated Airy moment characteristic functions for indices through 300 with max high-index error near 1e-6; finite numerics not substitute for Airy asymptotics.
